text: Over here! Sergeant Lenz locked me in. He is not coming back for me.
Go on. Count them for me.
Here, a full magazine. I keep count, you shoot.
From the stores. I know where everything is in this place.
A rifle. I have not carried one since Flanders. It comes back.
Thank you. I will pay for every round of it.
Then I come with the knife. A quartermaster always has a knife.
You are not from here. Good. I fed the men in the stairs for two winters, out of these stores. They found out.
You there! In the stores, behind the grille! I am no guard, I am locked in!
Hey! The barracks stores! Open up, I can help you!
